rationale: All three review lenses ran cleanly. All 8 acceptance criteria satisfied. The two-line value-formatting change and the metricValueClassName guard are correct: success-rate shows '—' when total=0 and color is suppressed; avg-duration shows '—' when total=0 or completed=0; 0.0%/red styling is preserved when completed runs exist. Edge-case lens found no issues. Blind lens flagged the redundant `s.total === 0` clause (cosmetic — implied by completed=0) and noted that all-in-progress success-rate shows 0.0% red (outside spec scope for this ticket). These are deferred, not blocking. Commit format and code quality pass. 3 integration tests added covering the key empty-state branches.

business_review.criterion: When total runs is 0, Success Rate displays '—' with neutral styling (not red 0.0%)
When total runs is 0, Average Duration displays '—' (not 0s)
If runs exist but all are still in progress, Average Duration displays '—'
If completed runs exist and all failed, Success Rate remains 0.0% with failed/red styling
business_review.notes: Logic path is correct: total>0 guard passes, getSuccessRateColorClass(0) returns text-failed-secondary. Test uses completed=0/failed=5 scenario; the canonical completed>0/all-failed path is logically sound but not directly test-asserted for color.

business_review.criterion: Completed, Failed, Running, and Cancelled counters display numeric values including 0
Scheduler statistic cards match compact analytics metric card sizing/density
business_review.notes: MetricsGrid/MetricCard from analytics widgets reused directly — no structural changes needed.

Existing scheduler run statistics loading and filtering must not regress
business_review.notes: Only display-layer changes; fetching, filtering, pagination untouched.
